svg.title: TRIUMPH-2 side effects by dose (type 2 diabetes)
svg.desc: Share of participants: nausea 14%, 21%, 28% on retatrutide 4, 9, 12 mg vs 8% placebo; dysesthesia (abnormal skin sensations) 4%, 6%, 7% vs 1%; stopped for adverse events or death 4%, 12%, 8% vs 5%.
